table.retrieve:
SELECT
	srbufferledger.srbufferinvcode ,
	srbufferledger.saleinvcode ,
	srbufferledger.date ,
	srbufferledger.srcatcode ,
	srbufferledger.custcode ,
	srbufferledger.salesmancode ,
	srbufferledger.discperc ,
	srbufferledger.flatdisc ,
	srbufferledger.misccharges ,
	users.username ,
	saleledger.date ,
	srbufferledger.headerno ,
	srbufferledger.posted ,
	srbufferledger.postdate ,
	srbufferledger.remarks ,
	accounts.name ,
	customer.address1 ,
	customer.city ,
	customer.phone,
	srbufferledger.originaldate,
	srbufferledger.modifiedby,
	srbufferledger.postedby,
	srbufferledger.invgstperc1,
	srbufferledger.smancode,
	srbufferledger.custrefno,
	srbufferledger.custrefno2,
	srbufferledger.custrefno3,
	srbufferledger.custrefno4 ,
	srbufferledger.patientcode,
	srbufferledger.invtotal,
	srbufferledger.machinename,
	gcode=0,
	srbufferledger.headerinvno,
	regno=space(60),
	aliasname= accounts.aliasname,
	srbufferledger.admissioncode,
	GuestRegNo=(SELECT G.RegNo FROM Guest G WHERE G.GuestCode=Srbufferledger.GuestCode),
	Srbufferledger.GuestCode,
	Srbufferledger.GuestCheckInCode,
	GuestBalance=0.00,
	StudentRegNo=(SELECT ST.RegNo FROM Student ST WHERE ST.StudentCode=Srbufferledger.StudentCode),
	Srbufferledger.StudentCode,
	StudentBalance=0.00,
	Srbufferledger.AccountFor,
	Srbufferledger.PaymentMode,
	Srbufferledger.PaymentAccCode,
	Srbufferledger.Amt,
	Srbufferledger.AmtBy,
	Srbufferledger.AmtDate,
	Srbufferledger.AmtReference,
	Srbufferledger.Outstandingamt,
	Srbufferledger.marked,
	Srbufferledger.PageSize,
	srbufferledger.CashAccCode,
	srbufferledger.CashTendered,
	srbufferledger.CashCharged,
	srbufferledger.CashBack,
	srbufferledger.retviabillsummary,
	srbufferledger.AdvanceTax,
	srbufferledger.AdvanceTaxAmt,
	srbufferledger.FBRPOSFee,
	SRBufferLedger.CashierShiftCode
FROM
	accounts,
	customer,
	users,
	srbufferledger 
	LEFT OUTER JOIN saleledger ON (srbufferledger.saleinvcode = saleledger.saleinvcode ) 
WHERE 
	( dbo.srbufferledger.srbufferinvcode = :ra_saleretinvcode ) and
	( srbufferledger.custcode = customer.custcode ) and 
	( srbufferledger.salesmancode = users.usercode ) and 
	( srbufferledger.custcode = accounts.acccode )
